Spent  a little time in NYC over the weekend after a concert for much-needed break from our lodging in N.J. We decided to head down to the Chelsea Pier suggested by @jayce_lambert…. We Stumbled across a cute little place off to the side that was surrounded by the hustle and bustle of a farmers market and a Sunday afternoon named Little Charli….OMG amazinggggg~ The meatballs were probably the best I’ve ever had~I could’ve sworn that there was a little Nonna cooking in the back and I wanted to meet her….:)The pizza was also top-notch if you’re in the area, give a visit you will NOT be disappointed. The menu is small and to the point. Everyone working there was so sweet ,warm and welcoming -Salvatore the Chef ( Owner?) even  invited us back for a pizza making class and continued to extend that offer to my son and GF who live in the city… ( which I will be doing soon)unfortunately we had to leave that night. If you’re looking for a last minute lunch or dinner spot this weekend, somewhere to take a larger group, or just looking for a date night spot - check out Little Charli in the West Village! This small restaurant is located right off of Bleeker Street across from the iconic John’s pizza. Going into it this dinner, we knew they had some tough shoes to fill. Their Roman-style pizzas cooked in a wood burning brick oven definitely put up a fight. Our dinner started with a Caesar salad, the off menu vodka pasta with burrata, and their meatballs as appetizers. For entrees, we ordered two pizzas, the Diablo and the Snow White. And lastly, you can’t leave here without ordering their Nutella s’mores pie for dessert. Every dish is truly delicious. We probably wouldn’t order the Snow White again, but the Diablo, meatballs, and vodka pasta are all must orders. 

Every Sunday and Monday, Little Charli also does a pizza making class, which we suggest you check out! It is $85 for your own pizza, appetizers, and a dessert. Perfect for a date night or GNO! 

Hopefully you stop by this spot soon! We are looking forward to trying their recently opened Hamptons restaurant this summer! 🍕🍝🍷

My experience at Eleven Madison Park was genuinely remarkable. I have never experienced service at this level before. This restaurant has been on my bucket list since 2021, when they announced that they were going entirely plant-based. Every year, I said I would treat myself, but I always found an excuse not to. I couldn’t justify the cost($394.39). 

This year, for me, was all about checking things off my bucket list. Dining at one of the World’s 50 Best Restaurants and the only Michelin three-star restaurant exclusively vegan, sounds fitting for my 35th birthday. 

From the moment I walked in, the staff knew who I was and greeted me by name. I was flabbergasted by that level of detail. Everything felt meticulously crafted. The way they moved around the restaurant in one direction felt like a symphony, in sync with the custom-made china exclusively made for the restaurant. The presence of Rashid Johnson’s artwork throughout the restaurant was beautiful. The service was beyond exceptional but also incredibly knowledgeable.

While I was there to celebrate my birthday, the experience was equally about research—exploring how I can continue to grow as a hospitality professional, observing what top restaurants are doing well, and considering how to apply those best practices to my own work.

The 9-course meal was not only beyond words; the presentation was magnificent as well. Every course was a piece of art. I am still on a high. I felt highly honored to get a tour of the kitchen, that was completely unexpected and special. The tour was definitely my highlight of the whole experience. 

Yes, it was expensive. Was it worth the money? For me, absolutely. Because I don’t collect things- I collect experiences.
Dichotomy…Eleven Madison to Patsy’s Pizza in the same night 😘 Why I love NYC!!!

i have no words to describe this meal, and i only wish my camera could do it more justice. every dish was remarkable and every bite a delight. thank you to my friends for the gift of an unforgettable experience!

I was able to dine at Eleven Madison Park for their lunch tasting menu when they were still plant-based. As a meat and seafood lover who always looks forward to the main course, this visit was slightly concerning but I eventually decided to give it a go, thinking that a three star restaurant would be different. The 2 hour lunch was impeccable - the serve was unlike anything I had experienced at a fine dining restaurant and so was the food. The explanation that goes into every single course, especially the ones that are served table side (the cocktail and the potato) was impressive and it truly made me feel what it’s like to dine at one of the world’s top restaurants.

Some standouts were the cocktail/mocktail that they make in front of you (while the taste wasn’t it for me, the explanation and the process that goes into this course was memorable) and the main - a potato dish that is smoked and paired with land caviar. One side note - while each dish is a work of art, I feel like some might think that the flavour profile is redundant especially towards the end. The food was salty overall for me, but everything else made up for it. Would 100% recommend despite the price.

I had a wonderful dinner with Sharon Thursday night at Eleven Madison Park (elevenmadisonpark), to celebrate her birthday. 

Chef Daniel Humm’s three-Michelin-star restaurant is the ultimate special occasion restaurant. They recently changed their vegan-only menu to now include some seafood and poultry options, courses that change every season. Thursday, the eight courses included a leek salad, a remarkable collard green dumpling, scallops, soba with white truffles, butter-poached lobster, smoked potatoes with caviar, some pretty terrific bread with onion butter, and duck. And for dessert, birthday cake, of course. 

In a nice surprise, we were invited to take a tour of the kitchen, which was very cool. 

It was nice to be able to celebrate Sharon’s birthday ON her actual birthday, as we were unable to do so last year. 

Great food. A beautiful space. Impeccable service. Good conversation. A terrific New York night out. #finedining #elevenmadisonpark #nyc #birthdaydinner

You know, life really is about creating memorable experiences.  We live in an era where so much is about having an online presence.  If you’re not online, you’re left out of the loop and miss out on what other’s may be doing.  If you even care to know.

Tonight, I solidified a new and beautiful friendship.  What started out as a swipe left on a dating app has evolved into a reality of friendship.  Cast aside our obvious differences, my friend Ilo has an amazing soul.

Tonight, for our first time meeting in person rather than this era of text, we enjoyed a Napoleon Italian tasting experience with five other strangers.  And you know what?  We had a blast!  What started as one new friend, has blossomed into five others. 😊

If Matthew were here looking down on me right now, he would be so proud of how much I’ve grown as a man.  He was my voice and the life of the party.  It’s now me being the voice of adventure.

Thank you Ilo for coming out with me tonight!  I’m so happy to have finally met you.  And I’m looking forward to future get togethers on this journey called life! 😘😊🤪🫢😭🤓😜🙏 and whatever life’s curveballs throws my way!

The event was curated around the theme of the rose because as the legend goes, industrial heir and playboy Gunter Sachs, upon meeting French actress Brigitte Bardot, dropped hundreds of roses from his helicopter onto La Madrague, her St. Tropez villa. They married on Bastille Day 1966 in Las Vegas. The met Andy Warhol that summer and Sachs commissioned two series of portraits: one of Bardot, and one of himself. 

The portrait auctioned is one of eight from that series.

Upstairs from Eleven Madison Park (@elevenmadisonpark), Clemente Bar (@theclementebar) blurs the lines between art, food, and mixology. 🍸

A collaboration between Chef Daniel Humm (@danielhumm) and artist Francesco Clemente (@clementestudio), the space is intentional in every detail, from the paintings on the wall to the custom dinnerware we created for them.

We stopped by to see how the team is using our dinnerware, designed specifically for their plant-based tasting menu at The Studio, the bar’s nine-seat counter. There, we caught up with Chef Mariana Schurt (@marianaschurt), Senior Sous Chef who manages The Studio, who shared how each dish and pairing is crafted to feel immersive, personal, and alive.

We got to witness the process for one of our favorite dishes on the menu: a soba course of asparagus, snow peas, and shiso, plated in a custom Jono Pandolfi Ramen Bowl. 

A huge thank-you to Chef Mariana and the Clemente team for welcoming us behind the counter.

Is Dyker Heights worth adding to your NYC bucket list? 

I finally went and here’s what you should know.
Would I recommend it if you’re short on time or visiting NYC for the first time? Honestly… maybe not.
 But if you love Christmas lights, local traditions, and something different from Midtown chaos, Dyker Heights is a fun detour.

Good to know before you go: • Dress warm, as everything is outdoors • please be mindful that it’s a residential area • During the weekends they have hot chocolate and snacks for sale • Guided tours are available, or take the R train to Bay Ridge

Crowds can get intense, so weeknights are the best time to visit if you’re looking for a more relaxed experience.

With love, care, and pure intention, we continue to create positive impact within our communities — and our Purple Christmas Celebration is a true reflection of that mission.

Purple Christmas started because our founder once experienced the holidays while living in a domestic violence shelter and understood firsthand how heavy that season can feel for survivors and their children. What began as a way to bring warmth, dignity, and joy into shelter spaces has grown into a tradition rooted in community, healing, and hope. This event is deeply personal to us, and it represents everything Sisters In Purple stands for: showing up, loving loudly, and making sure families know they are not alone.

This was more than a toy drive — this is what it looks like when a community comes together with the right intentions. From laughter and smiles to moments of genuine connection, our children left feeling like they were surrounded by family that truly loves and cares about them. ☕🎨🎄

We extend our deepest gratitude to the partners who helped make this moment possible:
💜 @riseprojectnyc 
💜 @projectechony 
💜 BK Alumnae Deltas
💜 Xi Phi Omegas
💜 The Harlem Sigmas

A heartfelt thank you to @shestillgotthejuice from Jumpin Jen’s, our amazing decorator and hostess with the mostest — from hot cocoa and cookie decorating to coloring, games, and joyful activities, she created a space where our children could simply be kids and feel deeply cared for.

And a huge shoutout to @angies.dad , who stepped in like a true superhero to provide our community with fresh haircuts, helping our families feel confident, seen, and uplifted during the holidays. 💇🏽‍♂️🦸🏾‍♂️

Thank you to every donor, volunteer, and supporter who made our families feel loved and reminded them that hope is real and people truly do care.

We are so excited to watch Purple Christmas continue to grow bigger and brighter each year — because when we move with intention, community becomes magic. 💜✨

Today I wanted to share a different take on pick playing. 
On Beatles “I Saw Her Standing There” Paul McCartney is using his classic Hofner Bass with a pick. He is playing closer to the neck to make this warmer tone that we hear. I chose to play more in the middle on the bass, because I was having a very hard time on playing this line clean at this tempo at the neck. I find it harder to control the bass there with a pick, and it really goes to show how great a bassist he is! He’s take is quite clean!

This year’s Christmas table felt less like a meal and more like a quiet 17th century still life. I kept thinking of the Dutch masters and how they painted abundance with restraint, honoring texture, shadow, and time. Nothing hurried, nothing overstated. Just presence.

At the center: a honey and tarragon roasted chicken, lacquered, golden, and sweet. Around it, charred broccolini with dark edges and vividly green within. 

There’s something deeply moving about arranging food the way an artist composes a canvas. Each element placed with care, knowing it will soon disappear. A fleeting moment of beauty, meant to be savored and then gone. This is the kind of luxury I love most: warmth, nourishment, and the quiet poetry of a table shared! 

X.O.

Had the MOST fun at @hudsontable in Hoboken for their 3 course chef competition 👩🏼‍🍳 this was a mixed between iron chef & chopped where we, the audience, were the judges ! The chefs had mystery ingredients and had to incorporate them between appetizers, entrees, and dessert with their own unique flair. 45 mins for the appetizer, 35 for the entree, and 25 for the dessert! Swipe to the end to see what our mystery ingredients were!! Chef Andrew and Chef Kim were so creative in developing these dishes & they truly were such high quality, just bursting with flavor. While I don’t have the full beautiful descriptions of these dishes, I’ll try to recall them. HIGHLY recommend doing this!!! 

Apps:
Chef andrew 👨‍🍳: crab “tortellini” soup in a super savory brother with mushrooms & blanched Swiss chard
Chef kim👩‍🍳: deconstructed crab Rangoon with a papaya slaw and the most perfectly salted wonton shell

Entrees:
Both prepared a flank steak 🥩 but with diffeeent flavor profiles. Chef kim’s was more acidic with a nice chimichurri, refried beans, and this Swiss chard leaf side that had a nice balancing bitter taste. Chef andrew’s was a mexi-Mediterranean styled marinade with papaya garnish, refried beans, and had the most incredible kick to it. 

Dessert:
Chef Andrew👨‍🍳: pretzel crusted pie with peanut butter filling and a bourbon honey caramel drizzle topped with crème fraiche 🥨 🥧 🥜🍯
Chef Kim👩‍🍳: papaya and toasted coconut ice cream with crushed pretzels and coconut shavings 🥥 🍨 
Both of those were out of this world. I NEVER would’ve reached for a papaya ice cream but this changed my life. Craving it rn. The peanut butter pie tho…knocked my socks off. As chef was preparing this dish in front of us I quite literally licked the bowl clean after he filled the pie crusts (with a spoon ofc). That bourbon honey caramel was absurd as well. 

I genuinely don’t know how I’m so surprised at how incredible this food was but it really was. The experience was amazing as well, I am astounded at how the chefs keep their composure and hold conversations with the crowd so calmly as the clock is counting down. Truly such a fun experience and would 1000000% recommend !!!

Happy Holidays- it really is the most wonderful time of the year! 

And to celebrate this Holiday Season, I invite to indulge in our new  Innovative, a Nostalgic Dessert: The Italian Rainbow Cookie Baked Alaska — Debuts at TUCCI – New York, Delmonico’s sister restaurant

In true Delmonico’s fashion—where culinary innovation and heritage have always intertwined—TUCCI – New York unveils a dazzling new creation: the Italian Rainbow Cookie Baked Alaska. This dessert is more than a confection; it’s a story baked in layers—Italian tradition, New York nostalgia, & an enduring Delmonico’s legacy.

The Italian rainbow cookie—those beloved almond-cake layers tinted in the spirit of the tricolore—rose from Italian-American bakery cases in New York in the late 19th & early 20th centuries, a sweet emblem of pride, belonging, and family memories.

And then there’s the legend: the dessert we know today as Baked Alaska, long linked to Delmonico’s and the theatrical wonder of “hot” & “cold” on one plate. The Delmonico’s story most often points to chef Charles Ranhofer, whose version appeared under the name “Alaska, Florida,”before the “Baked Alaska” name took hold more broadly in print—most notably with Fannie Merritt Farmer’s cookbook in 1896.

Now restaurateur Max Tucci, grandson of Delmonico’s Oscar Tucci, fuses these two icons into a single, unforgettable finale. The Italian Rainbow Cookie Baked Alaska brings the almond richness and jewel-toned charm of the classic Italian-American favorite into the showmanship of Delmonico’s-style dining: The iconic Italian Rainbow Cookie, velvety gelato, and a meringue crown finished with that moment of flame that makes the TUCCI dining room lean in.

“It’s a celebration of my Italian ancestors, my Italian-American heritage—and, simply, evolution,” says Max Tucci. “Delmonico’s has always been about pushing culinary boundaries while honoring the past. It’s about moving forward, while looking back. At TUCCI, we’re carrying that Delmonico legacy forward—infusing Italian soul with New York swagger.”

🍝TUCCI🍝

Tucci is a NoHo hotspot with some of the best bread I have tasted and serving the largest chicken parm I’ve ever seen. 

We got a table at Tucci on a rainy day, and the inside was the perfect vibe of cozy and cool. ☔️🤩 We ordered the house made bread of course: rosemary focaccia and artisan sourdough- and both were divineee. 🥖🍞

Then we jumped into some apps, including the caviar topped arancini, which was delicious and indulgent, and the crispy artichokes, which had a great crunch and flavor. 😋 We also did the meatballs - omg. I was in LOVE with this sauce.🥫And the meatballs were so tender and juicy. 

For our ~primi~, we had to try the cacio e pepe e tartufo, and I think that was my favorite of the evening (probably because I love black truffle- who doesn’t?!) 🍄‍🟫 We also had the pesto gnocchi. soooo freaking good. 🍝

Our main dish was the chicken parm- a HUGE serving was bought to us slathered in incredible smoked vodka sauce and a healthy helping of cheese. 🍗🤤 We were so full, but you know the drill- we had to do dessert. 

The tiramisu was SO perfect as well as the bomboloni. ☕️🍩 what a fabulous way to end a fabulous meal! Absolutely will be returning next time i need a hearty italian dinner 🫶

Introducing the TUCCI Italian Rainbow Cookie Baked Alaska, where Italian soul meets New York swagger — only at TUCCI – New York, Delmonico’s Sister Restaurant!

In true Delmonico’s fashion—where heritage and innovation intertwine—TUCCI – New York unveils a dazzling new creation: the TUCCI Italian Rainbow Cookie Baked Alaska.

This dessert is more than confection—it’s a story baked in layers of Italian tradition, New York nostalgia, and Delmonico’s enduring legacy.

The TUCCI Italian Rainbow Cookie, born in early 1900s New York bakeries, was a symbol of pride and belonging—three almond cake layers in the colors of the Italian flag, brushed with apricot jam and cloaked in chocolate.

The Baked Alaska, created at Delmonico’s in 1867 by Chef Charles Ranhofer, celebrated the Alaska Purchase—ice cream and sponge encased in meringue, kissed by flame. A showstopper of luxury dining and pure Delmonico’s drama.

Now, restaurant royalty & restaurateur Max Tucci, grandson of Delmonico’s Oscar Tucci, along with his confection culinary team fuses these two icons into one unforgettable dessert—a harmony of nostalgia and innovation. Jewel-toned layers, velvety gelato, and a meringue crown torched to perfection.

 “It’s a celebration of my Italian ancestors, my Italian-American heritage and simply, evolution,” says Max Tucci. Delmonico’s has always been about pushing boundaries while honoring the past. At TUCCI, we carry that flame forward—infusing Italian soul with New York swagger.”

More than dessert—it’s "culinary history reborn" in Italian colors, kissed with fire, and served with legacy.

For my last architecture project in NYIT this year, I designed a three-story artist house for Kimsooja located in Red Hook, that draws from Marcel Breuer’s Hooper House in its linear, cantilevered forms and courtyard organization.  A raised cross-laminated timber volume creates shaded circulation at ground level while long horizontal spaces and balconies maintain continuous movement and framed views along the facade.  The program gradates from public workspace below to semi-public display and gathering spaces, and finally to private living and garden spaces at the top.  Inspired by Kimsooja’s To Breathe series, diffraction-film glass rooms—represented in the physical model with iridescent acrylic panels, miniature figures, and layered landscaping—wrap corners and weave interiors in shifting color.

I signed a lease for my new studio in Sunset Park on October 30. Six days later -six weeks after the fire- I got access to my old studio. 

I needed to quickly document as soon as I got in, but it wasn’t until after I left that I could see how “normal” everything looked in this photo. It’s like I just stepped away from my desk.

It may sound weird, but this photo makes me smile, because even after this disaster, my space was inviting and cozy.

I’m ready to move forward with my social media focusing on getting settled in my new space and posting new work. 

There has been and still is a lot for me to process. I’ve had some valuable insights and breakdowns along the way.

If you are interested in hearing and seeing more details about my experience inside my studio and making the difficult decision to leave 97% of my stuff behind, please DM me your email address if you’re not already on my mailing list. 

I was hoping to get an email out before Thanksgiving, but my brain moves much faster than my body these days. We’ll see.

Wishing you all a beautiful holiday!

A common question we see from Excel power users 👇
 “Can I create dependent dropdowns in monday.com like Excel?”
Here’s the expert answer:
❌ NOT THAT:
 Trying to recreate true Excel-style dynamic dropdowns.
 monday.com doesn’t currently support dropdown options that change dynamically based on another column’s value, and forcing it leads to messy data and fragile setups.
✅ DO THIS (the expert approach):
 Design around the platform using proven patterns:
• Use a category column (Fruits / Vegetables)
 • Use automations to clear or reset the second column when the category changes
 • Or split into separate columns (Fruit Type / Vegetable Type) and show or hide them with automations
 • If data is collected via Forms, use conditional logic to show the correct dropdown automatically
The result?
 ✔ Clean data
 ✔ Fewer mistakes
 ✔ A system that scales instead of breaking
At Monday Wizard, we help teams stop fighting the platform and start designing systems that actually work inside it.

Excel logic ≠ monday logic,  and that’s not a limitation, it’s a design choice.

During Climate Week, we were tapped by Forager Project to orchestrate an intimate dinner bringing together leaders for real talk about federal funding cuts and their impact on our food supply.

The goal: Meaningful dialogue, not just networking.

The result: A full house and the kind of deep conversation that drives change.

Huge thanks to @LeBasqueNYC for hosting us and preparing a delicious meal that elevated the entire experience. 

This is what strategic communications looks like in action: Creating the moments where industry leaders can connect, challenge, and collaborate on the issues shaping our future. 

Proud to partner with brands like Forager Project who aren’t afraid to lean into the hard conversations.

Last night we celebrated the spirit of my friend Angie, as this award is so aptly named for.

There have been many iterations of my life - 17 to 26 I was a dancer & I was welcomed into the Ballroom Community with open arms, open doors, open couches when I needed a place to stay.  I was loved & nurtured and I was safe. 

I’m blessed that many of the people who I grew with at this time are still here to tell their story & continue the work that began decades ago.  But many of my friends are no longer alive to tell their story and so we must continue their legacy for them.  @uncensoredspirit  is a force in the LGBTQIA that championed this new initiative that secured a brand new building that provides housing, healthcare, food & mental health services to the community of young adults that are often thrown away - first by their families and then by society.

You can have whatever beliefs you like, but I assure you - until everyone is safe, no one is safe. Until everyone is housed, you too are a few paychecks away from being unhoused, until everyone is fed, we all can go hungry and until we all understand that every human being has the right to exist, none of us should feel so sure that our right to exist is a given. 

My heart is full, it’s filled with gratitude for the beautiful life I am so privileged to have and it is filled with gratitude for the struggle that I had to go through to get here. I am grateful for that struggle. I am grateful for my friends that showed up. I am grateful for the opportunities that keep coming my way because of these people.

Love truly is the message.

הדולר בשפל של 3 שנים. מה זה אומר על הכסף שלנו? 

השקל מתחזק, והדולר ירד ל-3.186 ₪, רמה שלא ראינו מאז 2020. 
מאחורי זה עומדים כמה גורמים:
1. מוסדיים מוכרים דולרים, כדי להשקיע באפיקים ארוכי טווח בשקלים.

2. ירידה בריבית הדולרית הצפויה, פוגעת באטרקטיביות של ההשקעה בדולר.

3. עודפי יצוא והייטק, עדיין תומכים בשקל, למרות האתגרים

ומה זה אומר למי שחי ומרוויח בשקלים?

1. החופשות והקניות אונליין קצת זולות יותר, לפחות זמנית.

2. יבואנים מרוויחים – אבל זה לא בהכרח יתגלגל לצרכן.

3. השקעות בדולרים? גם אם הרווחתם בנייר הערך, ייתכן שהפסדתם בשער המט"ח.

4. יצואנים נפגעים, הכנסות בדולרים שוות פחות שקלים.

● נקודה קריטית: מי שלא בודקת את חשיפת המטבע בתיק ההשקעות שלה עלולה להפסיד גם כשהשוק עולה.

⚡️ טיפ: כשמתחילה להשקיע, לא רק מה שקונים חשוב, אלא גם באיזה מטבע.

BROOKLYN / MANHATTAN 🌇 

DAY 1 !

Arrivés la veille à 23h heure locale ( 05h heure française 🫠 ), quelques heures de sommeil à peine et debout avec l’envie de découvrir la vibe New-yorkaise.

Programme du jour: pont de Brooklyn et alentours en se laissant aller à flâner au rythme de nos envies avec la forme/fatigue du jour.

Ce qu’on a finalement fait:

📍Dumbo
-> au croisement Whasington et Water street, pause photo 📸

📍Brooklyn
-> traversée du pont 🌉

📍Manathan
-> vue sur la statue de la liberté 🗽 

📍Wall Street
-> si tu es superstitieux, va toucher les BIP* du taureau, ça porte bonheur 🐂

📍China Town + Little Italy
-> pause repas 🍜

📍Soho
-> repérage shopping 🛍️ 

📍Pont de Brooklyn 
-> une deuxième fois pour le voir de nuit 🌃

30K pas 👟 au compteur, les enfants ont suivis à la perfection, c’était pourtant risqué avec si peu de sommeil. Et dans ces moments je me remercie d’avoir fait qu’ils soient si débordant d’énergie. 🙏🏼

Mon ressenti:

J’ai adoré Manhattan, la vue en traversant le point est indescriptible, vraiment ! Je me sens très chanceuse d’avoir pu voir la neige qui a fait le bonheur des enfants et d’avoir eu avec ça un temps magnifique. ❤️

I’ve docked an extra 5 points from the total because last time I was here there were two men having sex in the larger stall which made the experience … less pleasant. Step it up Saks, the people are disappointed.

N-am mai spus niciodata acest lucru nimanui.
Aici s-a nascut Avenue Hotels, la Saks pe 5th Avenue, in 2013.

Cam in aceasta perioada…
Primisem un gift card de 2-5000$ cadou de ziua mea de la amicul meu, M. 

Nu mai tin minte suma exact, dar era suficient pentru a cumpara orice voia o pustoaica de 23 de ani.

Eram fascinata de New York. Iar Saks… parea un loc din care nu imi voi cumpara ceva vreodata.

Dar nicicand sa nu spui niciodata.

Zona din jur este plina de hoteluri. Pe fiecare avenue, there is a 5 star hotel. Got it? Avenue Hotels.

Veneam dintr-o alta lume, complet. De la Tecuci… Nici nu mai stiu daca aveam vreun bulevard in oras. Altii nu indrazneau nici sa viseze ca pot iesi din “comuna”.

Eu tot ce stiam sa fac… era sa visez.

Dar, de cand ma stiu, cei din jurul meu n-au facut altceva decat sa imi sugrume visele. Parintii, partenerii, prietenii… 

N-am inteles de ce. Acum abia inteleg. Nu este despre visele mele, ci despre impotenta lor de a ma cuprinde.

Ei nu au crezut nicio clipa ca ceea ce am realizat ar putea fi posibil. Altfel, faceau totul fara mine. 

Doar increderea lor nestramutata in abilitatile mele ne-a adus atat de departe. Cumva, au zis da la toata nebunia mea.

Mama, de sine statatoare, este incapabila de decizii mari. Nu isi poate asuma riscuri. Ii este frica. Pana nu are acordul meu, nu intra in proiecte periculoase.

Curajul de a ma suprima nu e nou. E mecanism de protectie. Este frica de dinaintea unei miscari mai mari decat poate gestiona. Daca dispar eu, cine mai gestioneaza? 

Amuzant este ca a produs efectul opus.

Apropo, mi-am cumparat cizme. Gucci. Inca le am.

Still in awe of the ripple effect that intentional decisions can create.
When a company like Saks and Neiman Marcus chooses to collaborate with a small, woman-led, purpose-driven brand… they’re not just placing an order. They’re choosing where their dollars go. They’re choosing who they support. And they’re choosing the kind of world they want to help build. 🤍🪡

This special collaboration with @saintynelsen is a perfect example of what’s possible when creativity + community + shared values come together. Each ornament-sized, needlepoint Bauble Stocking in this collection tells a story of tradition, artistry, and meaningful memories made in your home — while also creating meaningful work in another.

Every single piece is handcrafted through @good.threads , our incredible needlepoint partner in Haiti that is a Certified B Corporation — meaning they meet the highest standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability. In simple terms? They prove that business can be a force for good 🌍✨ That fair wages, ethical work environments, and long-term community impact matter.

When you support this collaboration, you’re not just purchasing a beautiful heirloom made to last a lifetime.
You’re supporting mothers.
You’re supporting families.
You’re supporting sustainable, dignified work.
And you’re helping preserve a beloved holiday tradition — one thoughtful gift at a time 🎄🤍

Grateful beyond words for partners who believe in the power of mindful consumption and meaningful storytelling through design.

Thank you @saks 🤍
Thank you @neimanmarcus 🤍
Thank you @saintynelsen for creating beauty with intention 🤍

caption:
The Bauble Stockings tradition will always be my favorite part of Christmas morning 🎁✨

In our home, these ornament-sized heirloom stockings hold the final, most-thoughtful gift of the season—the one that brings the biggest smile, creates the warmest memory, and holds the sweetest surprise.

Some families tuck a handwritten clue inside 📝, others put a meaningful keepsake, an experience gift, or a little note that makes someone feel truly seen. However you use it, the Bauble Stocking is meant to gather everyone close and create a moment you never forget.

Each one is stitched by hand in Haiti, creating meaningful work for the artisans who bring them to life. And year after year, families add new designs, build traditions, and make memories together that last a lifetime ❤️🎄

A little stocking with a big heart.
A tradition you’ll cherish forever.

The steak is superb but you must must must get the creamy spinach carbonara. This is a true evolution and culture shift to the classic steakhouse creamed spinach. By adding egg, by adding that cured meat, by avoiding the wilt on the spinach, they have created a deeper, more complex, more savory, more worth-eating-slowly flavor. It's significantly better, to the point that others should steal from them.

The steak itself was a porterhouse for two cooked to medium well. The meat quality is great and they did the reverse sear well. It's a steakhouse that does live up to the name.

The corn looks like regular good corn but I also recommend getting this for its replacement of butter with bone marrow. That makes the dish heavier, which for corn is a good thing as corn is IMO a heavy -- if sweet, still heavy -- dish.

The vibe of this place is great, the music is not too loud, and they definitely choose differently with the music. Is it classic rock? No. Is it good enough to enjoy being with friends? Yes.

Highly recommend, yes for the steak and yes for the corn but HELL YES FOR THAT CREAMED SPINACH CARBONARA.

We’re proud to share our roots with Brooklyn. Whether it’s a comforting bowl of Tom Yum soup, a vibrant Pad Thai, or our signature Chef’s creations, our goal is simple: to make every guest feel like family. 🥢✨ Come join us at Khaosan — Brooklyn’s Thai restaurant where tradition, flavor, and community come together. 💚

We never forget our roots. As a Thai restaurant, our journey is deeply connected to the traditions and culture we come from. Last year, while browsing food photos online, I was instantly captivated by a Thai restaurant framed in a bloom of flowers – that was Khaosan Thai. 🌸 I finally had the chance to visit, and I must say: it exceeded all expectations. From the ambience to the artistry of the dishes and, most importantly, the flavors, everything was executed to perfection. Few restaurants manage to score high in every detail – this one absolutely does.

🍸 Cocktails First

⭐Pear No.1 – refreshing, fruit-forward, and layered with subtle flavors.

⭐White Lychee Sangria – among all the lychee cocktails I’ve tried, this one truly stands out with its complex, balanced notes.

🦀 A Crab Feast
I went all in on crab dishes – three different styles, each impressive in its own way:

⭐Crab Cakes – deceptively modest in appearance, but generously packed with delicate shreds of crab meat.

⭐Crab Meat Fried Rice – a Thai staple, but here the eggs are extraordinary: silky like a custard yet fragrant like a perfect stir-fry.

⭐Spaghetti Soft Shell Crab – my absolute favorite of the night. Arriving with an irresistible aroma, it was bold, flavorful, and kissed with true wok hei.

🍛 More Highlights

⭐Thai Green Curry Roti (N) – rich, aromatic curry paired beautifully with warm, flaky roti.

⭐Seared Sea Bass in Sweet & Sour Sauce – theatrically flambéed at the table, tender fish complemented by a vibrant fruit-and-vegetable sauce.

⭐Mango Ice Cream with Sticky Rice – a playful hot-and-cold experience: the cool creaminess of ice cream against the comforting warmth of sticky rice.

Pad Thai is more than just Thailand’s signature dish – it is a culinary masterpiece as a way to introduce the world to Thai flavors 🇹🇭✨

At Khaosan, we honor this history by using traditional techniques and the finest ingredients – chewy rice noodles, fresh shrimp, tamarind, roasted peanuts, and a touch of palm sugar – all perfectly balanced to create harmony in every bite

It’s not just noodles. It’s the story of Thailand, reimagined with passion in the heart of New York City. A dish that defines who we are, and why once you taste it, you’ll never forget it 🤍

“ GO BIG OR GO HOME “ said by Chef Amita, Executive Chef of @khaosan_nyc 

Born and raised in Udonthani, Thailand, Chef Amita Phookaw discovered her love for cooking at an early age. Growing up with her grandmother—who loved preparing hearty home-cooked meals—Amita spent her childhood helping in the kitchen and learning the secrets of traditional Thai cooking.

By the age of 20, she was already mastering the art of Isaan cuisine, using fresh, homegrown ingredients harvested from her family’s garden. This connection to the land shaped her philosophy: only fresh, clean, and chemical-free ingredients can bring out the true soul of Thai flavors.

In 2017, Amita moved to New York City, where she worked in both Japanese and Thai restaurants, gaining new techniques and broadening her culinary perspective. Combining these experiences with her deep-rooted Thai heritage, she opened Khaosan in 2022.

At Khaosan, Chef Amita stays true to her guiding principle: authentic Thai flavors crafted with the freshest ingredients. Every dish is a celebration of her grandmother’s cooking, her Isaan roots, and her culinary journey—bringing the warmth of Thai home cooking to every plate.

At Khaosan (@khaosan_nyc) in Brooklyn, NY, Thai flavors are reimagined with creativity while staying grounded in tradition. The menu brings together bold street food favorites and comforting mains that highlight the kitchen’s flavorful approach.

Start with the Fresh Shrimp Summer Rolls, light and crisp with a refreshing dip. The Curry Dumplings are soft and savory with a gentle kick, while the Shrimp Donuts offer a golden-fried bite with a soft center. The Crab Cakes are generously filled and served with a tangy sauce that balances their richness just right.

For mains, the Ocean’s Harvest Pad Thai takes the classic noodle dish up a notch with shrimp, squid, and scallops tossed in a sweet and tangy tamarind sauce. The Coconut Curry with Shrimp is creamy and fragrant, while the Coconut Curry with Beef Short Ribs delivers slow-cooked depth and comfort. The Garlic Udon with Hanger Beef rounds things out with chewy noodles tossed in savory garlic sauce and tender slices of beef.

Beyond the food, the space itself is stunning. It’s warm, detailed, and beautifully designed to reflect an authentic Thai experience! From the decor to the plating, Khaosan offers more than just a meal, it offers years of Thai culture and tradition.

✨ Гастрономические заметки Луны: Луна в Весах ✨

Если в вашей натальной карте Луна в Весах, ваше питание — это про гармонию, эстетику и внутреннее равновесие. 🌙♎
Вы едите не просто для сытости — вам важно, чтобы еда создавала настроение, баланс и внутреннюю лёгкость.

Вы любите:
• красивые, аккуратные блюда, которые «приятно есть глазами»;
• лёгкие сочетания: салаты, овощи, свежесть, что-то воздушное;
• гармоничные вкусы без резких перекосов — ни слишком жирно, ни слишком остро;
• эстетичную подачу, приятную атмосферу, красивую посуду;
• еду, от которой тело чувствует равновесие, а эмоции — спокойствие.

Луна в Весах — это человек, который настраивает себя на еду как на маленький ритуал красоты. Вам важно, чтобы тело не было перегружено — иначе страдает настроение, а вместе с ним и ваш внутренний баланс.

Эмоции Луны в Весах тесно связаны с ощущением внутренней и внешней гармонии, поэтому тяжёлая, хаотичная или «некрасивая» еда буквально выбивает из колеи. А зелёные овощи, эстетичная сервировка и легкая кухня помогают вернуться в состояние равновесия.

⚡ Совет дня: сделайте себе красивую тарелку. Салат с яркими акцентами или лёгкую пасту — еду, которая радует глаз. Такая забота мгновенно вернёт вам гармонию.

💬 У Луны в Весах часто есть свой «ритуал красоты» в еде — красивая чашка, определённая вилка, любимый бокал. Какой ваш?

💫💫💫💫💫💫💫💫

🔍 Как узнать, есть ли у вас Луна в Весах

Очень просто:
	1.	Зайдите на любой сайт с расчётом натала:
• astro.com
• astro-seek.com
• astrolibrary.org
	2.	Найдите символ Луны ☽ в карте.
	3.	Если рядом указано ♎ Libra / Весы — значит ваша Луна в Весах.

В приложениях (TimePassages, AstroMatrix) знак Луны отображается сразу в разделе Moon.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated for Halloween — they really go all out with the festive details, making the entire space feel warm, fun, and inviting. It’s the perfect spot for a celebration or special event — the atmosphere, layout, and attention to detail make it ideal for groups.

Our waiter, Jefferson, was wonderful — attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. The food was delicious, the service was top-notch, and the overall experience couldn’t have been better.

Highly recommend Da Rosario’s for anyone looking for great food, a beautiful ambiance, and a team that truly cares about their guests! 🎃🍝
